content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Payout Transactions ## slug: payout-transactions ## seoTitle: Payout Transactions ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End For this type of {{variable.Object_Transaction}}, {{variable.Product_Stripe}} makes deposits (payouts) from your available account balance into your bank account. The account balance consists of different types of {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s (e.g., payments, refunds, etc.). Stripe Payouts automatically relate to charges and transfers included within them. This helps reconcile which charges are included in which bank transfers. ![H_01_12_payout transaction 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_12_payout%20transaction%201.png){height="" width=""} {{variable.Product_Stripe}} creates payout {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} via {{variable.Task_Webhook}}s. *Payout {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s cannot be manually created in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}.* Once a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} with {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = "Payout" has been created and {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} = "Paid", all charge {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s are related to the payout {{variable.Object_Transaction}} through the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Payout}} field on the charge {{variable.Object_Transaction}} via the daily charges batch job. Payouts must relate to original charges, refunds, disputed refunds and transfers so you can successfully prove and document that account balances agree. ![H_01_12_payout transaction 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_12_payout%20transaction%202.png){height="" width=""} In addition to relating a Payout {{variable.Object_Transaction}} record to all original charges, refunds, and transfers we provide an [out-of-the-box report](/v1/docs/reports-1) on payouts and related {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s. ## Batch Job Process The Blackthorn | Payments Set Payout batch job processes payout {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s. For a payout {{variable.Object_Transaction}} to be included, the following must be true. * {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = "Payout" * {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} = "Completed" * {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} = "Paid" The payout {{variable.Object_Transaction}} record then enters a timestamp in the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PayoutProDat}} field that shows when the record was processed so the batch job does not process it again. This batch job can also be triggered manually. Go to the {{variable.Tab_PT_BTPayAdmin}} tab, click the {{variable.Tab_BTPTAdmin_BatchJobs}} tab, and click {{variable.Button_PTAdmin_Bat_PayoutHisto}}. ## Troubleshooting If you have received an error with your {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s or have a question, please view our [Troubleshooting](/v1/docs/troubleshooting-payments) page.
